title: Beth Alpha Cucumber - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Sweet Baby Cucumbers
description:
Grow your own delicious, burpless Beth Alpha cucumbers at home!


KEY FEATURES
• Prolific yields of sweet, tender baby cucumbers
• Thin, burpless skins that don't require peeling
• Compact growth habit, ideal for small spaces and containers
• Reliable and early cropping variety
• Recommended as a 'Best Buy' by gardening experts


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis sativus
Colour: Green
Season: Harvest July-October
Growth Habit: Vining (can be trained on canes or trellis)
Flavour: Mild, refreshing, sweet
Time to Harvest: 55-65 days from seeding (July-October from May-June planting)


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Fertile, well-drained, moisture-retentive soil
Watering: Water regularly to maintain even moisture; keep consistently moist to avoid bitterness
Spacing: 40-60 cm spread
Height: 1-1.5 metres
Spread: 40-60 cm
Hardiness: Half-Hardy Annual (UK)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out in May-June into large pots, growing bags, or greenhouse borders after hardening off.
• Support plants with canes or trellis to encourage straight fruits and save space [irishplantsdirect.ie].
• Feed weekly with a balanced fertiliser once fruits begin to form.
• Harvest fruits frequently when small and tender (4-6 inches) to encourage continuous production [premierseedsdirect.com].
• Remove lower leaves to improve airflow and reduce disease risk.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
